Q5817.reason: Taxing nonresident photographers on in-state earnings while exempting residents from the same income discriminates against out-of-state citizens in pursuing a livelihood, which the Article IV Privileges and Immunities Clause forbids.

Q5819.reason: Carpal tunnel is median-nerve compression causing nocturnal paresthesia in the lateral 3.5 digits, and rheumatoid synovial swelling is a recognized cause.

Q5827.reason: A left parasternal heave or impulse is produced by an enlarged or hypertrophied right ventricle lying against the anterior chest wall.
